# `vox-grammar-export`

**Crate:** `vox-grammar-export` · **Version:** `0.6.0` · **Target:** Library (`lib.rs`)

Exports the Vox grammar artifact for downstream tooling.

## Crate Overview

Grammar export schema + manifest types (TextMate, tree-sitter, EBNF targets).
